    .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 40px; }
    .brand-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; }
    .brand-mark img { display: block; width: 48px; height: auto; filter: brightness(0); }
    .brand-name { font-family: "Mark Pro", Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .035em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    :root { --surface: #fff; --icon-ink: color-mix(in srgb, var(--agent-accent) 80%, black); --selection: color-mix(in srgb, var(--agent-accent) 30%, white); color-scheme: light; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--text); background: var(--page); }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }
    main { padding: 40px 0; }
    main > * { width: calc(100% - 48px); max-width: 960px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
    .page-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 180px; align-items: start; gap: 40px; margin-bottom: 40px; }
    .page-header > div { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
    .page-header > .qr-card { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
    .qr-card { --qr-radius: 16px; --qr-padding: 14px; --qr-border: 1px; margin: 0; padding: var(--qr-padding); text-align: center; background: var(--surface); border: var(--qr-border) solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--qr-radius); }
    
    
    .qr-card img { display: block; width: 150px; max-width: 100%; height: auto; margin: 0 auto; }
    .qr-card figcaption { text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 600; }
    @media (max-width: 660px) { .page-header { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; } .qr-card { display: none; } }
    .eyebrow { color: var(--icon-ink); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 24px; }
    h1 { max-width: none; font-size: 48px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.045em; margin: 0 0 24px; }
    .intro { max-width: 900px; color: var(--muted-text); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }
    .controls { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; margin: 32px 0 0; }
    .controls-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
    .toggle { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--control-border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--control-bg); gap: 4px; }
    button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
    .toggle button { border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--control-text); padding: 10px 18px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
    .toggle button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--agent-ink); }
    button:where([data-capture-interaction-disabled]) { outline: 3px solid var(--icon-ink); outline-offset: 4px; }
    .icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; vertical-align: middle; }
    .symbol .icon { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
    .toggle button, .copy { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; }
    .toggle .brand-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
    :is(.copy, .qr-copy) :is(.success-icon, .error-icon) { display: none; }
    :is(.copy, .qr-copy)[data-copy-error] .copy-icon { display: none; }
    :is(.copy, .qr-copy)[data-copy-error] .error-icon { display: inline; }
    :is(.copy, .qr-copy)[data-copied="true"] .copy-icon { display: none; }
    :is(.copy, .qr-copy)[data-copied="true"] .success-icon { display: inline; }
    pre, pre code { -webkit-user-select: text; user-select: text; cursor: text; }
    ::selection { color: var(--selection-text); background: var(--selection); }
    .cards { display: grid; gap: 64px; }
    .step-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.8fr); gap: 40px; align-items: start; }
    .step-marker { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 24px; min-width: 0; margin-top: 12px; }
    .step-copy { }
    .step-title { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--icon-ink); font-size: 32px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.04em; }
    .step-purpose { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-text); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }
    .step-connector { display: block; height: 2px; width: calc(100% + 16px); background: var(--connector); }
    .step-row:nth-child(even) { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.8fr) minmax(0, 1fr); }
    .step-row:nth-child(even) .step-marker { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; text-align: right; }
    .step-row:nth-child(even) article { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
    .step-row:nth-child(even) .step-connector { margin-left: -16px; }
    @media (max-width: 660px) {
      h1 { font-size: 40px; }
      .cards { gap: 48px; }
      .step-row, .step-row:nth-child(even) { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
      .step-marker { margin-top: 0; }
      .step-row:nth-child(even) .step-marker { grid-column: auto; grid-row: auto; text-align: left; }
      .step-row:nth-child(even) article { grid-column: auto; grid-row: auto; }
      .step-title { font-size: 28px; }
      .step-connector, .step-row:nth-child(even) .step-connector { width: 120px; margin: 0; }
    }
    article { background: var(--card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
    .card-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 32px; }
    .card-heading > div { min-width: 0; }
    .card-heading .slug { margin: 0; }
    .symbol { flex: none; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 13px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--tile-bg); color: var(--icon-ink); }
    .build .symbol { background: var(--tile-bg); color: var(--icon-ink); }
    .card-heading h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.025em; }
    .slug { font: 14px/1.5 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--muted-text); margin: 0 0 24px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    .description { color: var(--muted-text); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 32px; }
    .code-wrap { position: relative; margin-top: auto; border-radius: 12px; overflow: visible; border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); }
    .code-header { border-radius: 11px 11px 0 0; height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--panel-border); gap: 8px; }
    .code-label { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted-text); }
    .copy { flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--control-border); color: var(--text); border-radius: 7px; padding: 5px 8px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 600; }
    .copy:where([data-capture-interaction-disabled]) { background: var(--hover); }
    :is(.copy, .qr-copy)[data-copied="true"] { color: var(--success); border-color: var(--success); }
    pre { border-radius: 0 0 11px 11px; margin: 0; padding: 16px; height: 192px; overflow-y: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: 14px/1.5 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; }
    pre:where([data-capture-interaction-disabled]) { outline: none; }
    .code-wrap:has(pre:where([data-capture-interaction-disabled]))::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 56px 0 0; z-index: 2; outline: 3px solid var(--icon-ink); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 0 0 11px 11px; pointer-events: none; }
    code { font: inherit; }
    .status { border-radius: 0 0 11px 11px; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; z-index: 1; max-height: 192px; background: var(--surface); margin: 0; padding: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--panel-border); color: var(--error); font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; overflow: hidden; }
    .copy-content { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font: inherit; }
    .copy-label { font: inherit; }
    .status:empty { padding: 0; border-top: 0; }
    :is(.copy, .qr-copy)[data-copy-error] { color: var(--error); border-color: var(--error); }
    .status.is-success { color: var(--success); }
    footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); margin-top: 40px; padding-top: 32px; color: var(--muted-text); font-size: 14px; }
    footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px 24px; }
    .footer-meta { display: flex; flex: 1 1 0%; min-width: min-content; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 16px; }
    .footer-version, .footer-copyright { white-space: nowrap; }
    footer.is-stacked { justify-content: center; text-align: center; }
    footer.is-stacked .footer-meta { flex-basis: 100%; justify-content: center; }
    footer.is-stacked .footer-copyright { flex-basis: 100%; }
    .footer-copyright { position: relative; }
    .footer-meta:not(.is-wrapped) .footer-copyright::before { content: '•'; position: absolute; left: -11px; }
    footer :is(form,.ph-form) { margin: 0; flex: none; }
    footer :is(form,.ph-form) button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; background: transparent; color: inherit; border: 1px solid var(--control-border); border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 11px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
    
    @media (max-width: 700px) { article { padding: 24px; } .code-header { gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; } }
    @media (max-width: 360px) { .copy .icon { display: none; } }
    body { overflow-x: clip; }
    .step-row.reveal-ready > * { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(var(--reveal-offset)); transition: opacity 600ms ease-out, transform 750ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
    .step-row > .step-marker { --reveal-offset: -64px; }
    .step-row > article { --reveal-offset: -64px; }
    .step-row:nth-child(even) > .step-marker { --reveal-offset: 64px; }
    .step-row:nth-child(even) > article { --reveal-offset: 64px; }
    .step-row.is-revealed > * { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    .step-row.reveal-ready:not(.is-revealed) > * { transition: none; }
